svg.aria-label: The controlled pair. Same family, same quantisation-aware ~4.5 bpw training, same caps, one box. Left: the three quality axes, bars carrying 95% confidence intervals at n = 164 / 120 / 50 — the difference on HumanEval is one problem, on MMLU-Pro seven. Right: decode for the same two files at the same cap, 28 against 59 tok/s
svg.title: The controlled pair. Same family, same quantisation-aware ~4.5 bpw training, same caps, one box. Left: the three quality axes, bars carrying 95% confidence intervals at n = 164 / 120 / 50 — the difference on HumanEval is one problem, on MMLU-Pro seven. Right: decode for the same two files at the same cap, 28 against 59 tok/s
svg.desc: The controlled pair. Same family, same quantisation-aware ~4.5 bpw training, same caps, one box. Left: the three quality axes, bars carrying 95% confidence intervals at n = 164 / 120 / 50 — the difference on HumanEval is one problem, on MMLU-Pro seven. Right: decode for the same two files at the same cap, 28 against 59 tok/s — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
